title: Las Vegas UTV Tour
includes: 60-minute RZR Ride (up to 2 people per buggy)
Riding gear helmets, gloves and goggles
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
One hour of driving your own RZR side-by-side Off Road. two or four passengers per vehicle. Can alternate driving. You will be riding on desert trails located behind the ghost town in Goodsprings, NV thirty minutes south of the Las Vegas Strip. Whether it’s a duel in the desert or something a little less challenging we cater our tours to your groups skill level. This RZR tour has the most Panoramic views of the natural landscape. A standout feature of this ride is the Figure 8 track- a dynamic section of the trail designed to let riders unleash their full potential. Here, you will experience smooth, flowing turns, adrenaline-pumping berms and wide open spaces. This is about pushing your limits while maintaining control. Whether you're an experienced rider or a beginner looking for an exciting challenge. This tour is a perfect blend of technical and simple elements.
**Option for people who drive to us – The historical Pioneer Saloon (Bar and grill) located 1 mile from our riding area.
